answer_1.quote: We use a seq2seq generation model to convert QA pairs ... into context ...; we use a seq2seq generation model T5 to enrich the target sentence with the context ...; we evaluate the similarity between our final decontextualised claim sentence and the claim decontextualised by fact‑checkers using chrF.
answer_1.outputs: decontextualised claim sentences (generated claims) and extracted central sentences

answer_2.quote: We use the chrF as the evaluation metric for claim extraction ...; We also report Precision@k for sentence extraction and evidence retrieval; SARI and BERTScore are mentioned as alternative similarity metrics.

answer_4.quote: we asked a fact-checking professional to evaluate the quality of extracted sentences on the following two dimensions: 1) IsCheckWorthy: is the sentence worth checking? 2) IsCentralClaim: is the sentence related to the central idea of the article?
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rated each extracted sentence on two binary criteria: IsCheckWorthy and IsCentralClaim.
